model_notes: Opportunity is weighted separately from production.
Depth-chart role and injuries affect scores.
Roster need and positional scarcity are league-specific.
1-QB replacement value suppresses redundant waiver QBs unless the roster needs a starter.
Starter-slot and FLEX demand increase RB/WR value.
Redundant TE inventory is discounted when the roster already has depth.
K/DEF are intentionally de-emphasized in general waiver rankings.
Schedule is neutral until defensive matchup quality is added.
